personality_one_liner: A high-end, members-only private club offering exclusive access through rich, cinematic, and deep prestige visuals.

spacing.rule: Generous editorial spacing. Elements should breathe, mimicking the luxurious negative space of print magazines.

do's: Use heavy blur (expo-blur) with translucent tint for tab bars and floating headers
Add glassmorphism to the digital membership User ID card, placing it over the abstract gold texture to create a 3D hologram card effect
Apply glass effects on floating action buttons and bottom-sheet handles
dont's: Never blur body content or list rows.
Never use pure transparent blurs without an underlying tint base (min 70% opacity) to guarantee readability

screens.name: Onboarding & Splash
screens.purpose: A cinematic welcome sequence that auto-generates the 'TOP-XXXXXXXX' User ID with an elegant reveal.

states.loading: Dark pulsing background with a single elegant spinner

screens.layout: Full-bleed background image overlaid with a 3-stop vertical gradient scrim (to surface inverse). The generated User ID sits at the center in display serif, with a bottom-anchored CTA 'Enter the Club'.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: The main dashboard acting as the club concierge, giving immediate access to the membership ID, current subscription usage, and live games.

states.loading: Skeleton of the Membership card and content grid
states.error: Centered glass pane with retry action

screens.layout: Use a vertical scrolling feed. The hero is the User ID Card (styled like a digital wallet pass) placed over an abstract texture with glassmorphism. Below that, chronologically stack the active subscription progress card, a 2x2 grid of quick actions in tinted icon containers (brandTertiary), a horizontally scrolling list of live games (Sridevi, Kalyan, Main Bazar), and an announcements banner.

screens.name: Games
screens.purpose: A prestige view of the three available games, showing their schedules and latest results.

states.empty: Centered gold icon, 'No active games today', primary CTA

screens.layout: Vertical list of thick, luxe cards. Each game card uses a subtle gradient or blurred photo backdrop, displaying the game title in Cormorant Garamond, live status chip, schedule, and the latest result in an oversized, high-contrast numeric display. Tapping pushes to Game History.

screens.name: Results
screens.purpose: Historical archive of game outcomes, laid out cleanly with high numeric hierarchy.

states.empty: Empty state illustration, 'No results logged yet.'

screens.layout: Date-grouped list. Minimal chrome. High contrast numeric outcomes with subtle dividers. Kept simple for fast scanning.

screens.name: Subscription & Payment
screens.purpose: Upgrade wall detailing the 2 tiers (Base vs Pro) and funneling into a manual UPI payment flow.
screens.layout: Presents a 'Centered Block' style view. Side-by-side or stacked tier cards. The Pro card should have a gold-tinted border/gradient to imply superiority. Left-aligned benefits list. Tapping a plan opens a bottom sheet for manual payment: displays the UPI ID (6303514885@ibl) and a generated QR Code (react-native-qrcode-svg). Followed by a sleek input field for the Payment Reference ID and submit. Post-submit shows a vertical status timeline (Pending -> Verified/Rejected).

screens.name: Notifications
screens.purpose: Feed of systemic and game updates.
screens.layout: Simple vertical list of notification cells. Unread items have a brandPrimary dot and slight surfaceTertiary background tint.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: User management, settings, theme toggle, and the secret gate to the Admin panel.
screens.layout: Top section features the User ID and an elegant initials avatar in a tinted circle. List rows for Settings (Theme, Language, Sound), Legal, and Help. Hidden admin entry triggers on 5 fast taps of the App Version string at the very bottom.

screens.name: Admin Dashboard
screens.purpose: Hidden panel for system management: users, games, results, payments, and audit logs.
screens.layout: Dense but clean utility layout (leaning slightly more functional but keeping the dark aesthetic). Tabs or a side drawer for managing entities. List views with search/filter for approving UPI payments.

hero_background.alt: Premium abstract texture for hero section

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the Glass/Luxe DARK & LIGHT personality. Use deep obsidian/midnight black for dark mode, and warm ivory/off-white for light mode.
BANNED COLORS: Blue, Purple, Indigo, Pink, Navy. Do not use these anywhere. Stick to the provided gold accents (Brand) and monochrome base colors.

Implement the User ID card on the Home Screen as a digital pass/wallet card using glassmorphism over the `premium_card_texture` image. It should look like a prestige black card or gold card depending on the tier.
Use react-native-qrcode-svg for generating the UPI QR code natively on the manual payment screen. Hardcode the UPI string into the generator.
Hide the admin panel strictly behind a 5-tap gesture on the App Version text in the Profile screen, leading to a PIN/Secret Code modal.
For typography, use Cormorant Garamond for display headers and Satoshi for body text. Ensure line-heights are generous.
When applying text over images (e.g., Splash, Hero cards), strictly follow the gradient-to-dark scrim pattern (top to bottom fade to >=70% surfaceInverse) to guarantee WCAG contrast compliance.
Ensure all interactive elements and buttons possess subtle haptic feedback mapping.
